name: nimiq-simple-faucet
description: Reusable self-hosted Nimiq faucet / payout service with strong abuse prevention and first-class AI-agent integration
author: Nimiq <richy@nimiq.com>

scripts.pre-merge: turbo run typecheck build test --filter=!@nimiq-faucet/e2e && pnpm config-reference:check

auditConfig.//1: GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (esbuild) and GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9 (vite) are dev-server vulnerabilities — neither esbuild's `serve` nor vite's optimized-deps endpoint is reachable in production builds (vitepress runs the static-output path; vitest is a test-only dev dep). Bumping past the fixed versions forces esbuild >=0.25, which breaks vitest 2.1.x's SSR runtime. Revisit once we upgrade vitest to a major that ships against esbuild 0.25+.
auditConfig.//2: Re-evaluate quarterly: if a new esbuild/vite advisory crosses into runtime reachability, drop the ignore and accept the vitest churn.
auditConfig.//3: Everything else pnpm audit would otherwise flag is patched via `pnpm.overrides` above rather than ignored: hono >=4.12.21 (GHSA-9vqf-7f2p-gf9v bodyLimit bypass, GHSA-69xw-7hcm-h432 hono/jsx tag-name HTML injection, GHSA-qp7p-654g-cw7p hono/jsx CSS injection, GHSA-p77w-8qqv-26rm cache Vary leakage), fast-uri >=3.1.2 (GHSA-q3j6-qgpj-74h6 path traversal, GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc host confusion), ip-address >=10.1.1 (GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g Address6 XSS). All reach the tree only via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0 / Fastify transitives and all take a clean patch bump without resolver churn. Adding 2026-05-29: brace-expansion >=5.0.6 (GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2 numeric-range DoS), ws >=8.20.1 (GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx uninit-memory disclosure), qs >=6.15.2 (GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26 stringify DoS). All three reach via @fastify/* + @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0 + Expo CLI; clean patch bumps in all cases. Bumped 2026-06-05: hono >=4.12.18 -> >=4.12.21 to patch 4 newly-published advisories — GHSA-xrhx-7g5j-rcj5 (IP-restriction middleware bypass for non-canonical IPv6), GHSA-3hrh-pfw6-9m5x (cookie helper Set-Cookie injection via unsanitised sameSite/priority), GHSA-f577-qrjj-4474 (JWT middleware accepts any Authorization scheme, not only Bearer), GHSA-2gcr-mfcq-wcc3 (app.mount() undecoded-path prefix stripping mis-routes percent-encoded paths); same @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0 / @hono/node-server transitive, resolves to hono@4.12.23 with no resolver churn. The uuid ignore is back (see //4) via a different chain — examples/react-native-claim-app > xcode@3.0.1.
auditConfig.//4: GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (uuid <11.1.1, missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when `buf` is provided) is reachable only via examples/react-native-claim-app > expo > @expo/cli > @expo/config-plugins > xcode@3.0.1 > uuid@7.0.3 — strictly dev-only Expo prebuild tooling. xcode uses uuid.v1() and never passes the `buf` parameter the advisory requires for exploitation. Re-evaluate if xcode is dropped or if a higher-severity uuid CVE crosses into runtime reach. Bumping past 11.1.1 would force xcode@3.0.1 onto uuid@11 (4 major-version jump) and likely break the Expo example app.
